checks.name: Public adult dinosaur accepts a second rider in a distinct native seat, while private access remains denied
The passenger follows movement and turns without self teleport spam and keeps independent look direction
Only the driver commands dinosaur attacks and the dinosaur cannot target its co-rider
Forced passenger exit preserves safe feet below a low ceiling without resistance masking collision
Guest Sneak removes only the guest; revoking public access preserves the owner driver
Driver Sneak ends both seats without promoting the passenger
High-seat exit protection follows actual ground distance and preserves longer or infinite effects
All four large adult species accept exactly two riders; small species and juveniles remain excluded
Revoking a public driver ends both seats even when the owner is the passenger
Turning sweeps the rear passenger arc and stops before a wall; queries do not load chunks
Swimming checks the second rider headroom and keeps both riders aboard in open water
Cancelled mounts, external teleports, mode changes, unload and carrier death remove reservations and helpers
Shutdown and a real restart leave no passenger helpers or inherited driving authority

red_regressions.observed: Guest vehicle none instead of ARMOR_STAND
Player bounding box intersects low ceiling immediately after access revocation
855 ticks of Slow Falling after an ordinary low ground dismount

limits: Native tests use disposable loopback Paper worlds and protocol777 Java clients, not official rendered clients.
The unload lifecycle check dispatches EntitiesUnloadEvent; it does not establish real distant mounted-chunk unload behavior.
The rotation query compares the loaded chunk count near spawn, not at an unloaded boundary.
The model probe uses the actual packet listener/wrappers with controlled engine discovery, scheduling and networking; reload checks clock state, not a full model rebuild.
The full Geyser/BetterModel runtime and official Java/Bedrock/console visual acceptance remain separate release gates.
The candidate plugin was not deployed to the live server.
